# ARTEX Penetration Test Report — Acme Corp

## Overview
- Scope: acme.com (including www / admin / api / shop / vpn subdomains)
- Confirmed findings: 6 (3 high · 3 medium · 2 low)
- Engine mode: exploring

## Key findings
1. **[High] Default admin credentials** admin.acme.com admin/admin123 → full admin panel takeover.
2. **[High] SQL injection** www.acme.com/search?q= → can read the acme_prod database.
3. **[High] IDOR** api.acme.com/v1/orders?id= → can read other users' orders without authorization (including phone/address).
4. **[Medium] Reflected XSS**, **exposed .git source**, **no login rate limiting**.

## Recommendations
- Force a password reset + enable MFA, ban default credentials on the admin panel.
- Parameterize the search endpoint's queries, encode output.
- Add object-level authorization checks to the API (IDOR), rotate to a strong JWT secret.

> (demo) This report is generated from mock data, for UI demonstration only.
